ns2:course.label: Advanced Analytical Chem Lab
ns2:course.description: Graduate-level laboratory course in chemical analysis meant to be taken concurrently with CHEM 520. Experiments in atomic and molecular spectroscopy, electrochemistry, and molecular separations cover areas relevant to modern chemical analysis with similar emphasis on sample manipulation, instrumentation and data analysis. Prerequisite: CHEM 315, CHEM 420, CHEM 442, and CHEM 444, or preparation in chemistry and physics equivalent to a major in the natural sciences or engineering at the bachelor's degree level.
